Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Let’s prepare a little surprise for when the boss gets back. A harmless prank. A playful goof. A welcome home present. Let’s cover her office with all the awesome foils and non-foils in this bundle! Her desk, her computer, her gold-framed print of Magritte’s The Treachery of Images. Everything. When she gets back, she’ll be so confused! It’ll be hilarious! She’ll probably say something legendary, like “Uh, what? I didn’t leave cards all over my office and gold-framed print of Magritte’s The Treachery of Images. That’s weird.” Classic.
Contents:
• 1x Break Room Disco Ball Made of Foils Bundle
• 1x Desk Fort Made of Non-Foils Bundle

When purchasing this unique product, please keep in mind that this Secret Lair Drop Series Sealed Product will ship out to you after the seller receives the product directly from Wizards of the Coast.

The estimated time frame for sellers to receive stock is not fixed, so it could be anywhere between 1 - 10 weeks for delivery.
